convertibility_reason: Uses MQL5 Standard Library expert framework (Expert.mqh, SignalMA_Simple_Crossover.mqh, TrailingMA.mqh, MoneyFixedMargin.mqh) which requires manual translation of the framework's signal weighting, threshold, and trailing logic to Python. Not a simple standalone indicator-based EA.

other_exits: Signal threshold close at 20 - opposite signal can close position if weighted signal meets threshold

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedMargin uses percentage of available margin to calculate lot size

custom_logic_notes: Uses CExpertSignal threshold system (open=20, close=20) with weighted filter (weight=1.0). Signal price level=2.0 affects deal execution price. The CExpert framework handles position management internally including reversal closes. Expert_EveryTick=false means bar-based execution only. Trailing uses EMA(92) as indicator-based trailing stop managed by CTrailingMA class.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the CExpertSignal threshold/weight voting system: signal score ranges 0-100, threshold filters determine if signal is strong enough to act. CSignalMAC crossover logic uses standard iMA handles but the scoring and threshold mechanism is framework-specific. Trailing stop logic from CTrailingMA follows EMA(92) - need to replicate the trailing step logic which adjusts SL to follow the MA. CMoneyFixedMargin calculates lots based on margin percentage - need to implement margin-based lot calculation. SL/TP are in points (95.0 and 670.0) - need to verify if these need 10x adjustment for 5-digit brokers or if the framework handles _Point conversion internally (it does via CExpert).
